interview.hardest_part: Progressing through many workdays with increasingly complex document rules while accurately inspecting small text, managing quotas, and making correct story choices.
interview.likely_failure: Early workday quota/citation failure caused by misreading documents, slow multi-step mouse interactions, or missing rule changes; later, failing to satisfy day-20 story and ending requirements.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Paused thinking between actions, persistent screenshots, ability to keep notes across attempts, simple click-and-drag controls, and restart persistence for learning.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Running workday clock, limited one input per step, small document text, precise dragging/stamping, escalating rule complexity, quota penalties, and branching storyline requirements.
